name: irctc-cypress-automation
description: IRCTC Ticket Booking Automation with Playwright production runner and Cypress legacy compatibility

scripts.build: npm --prefix ui install --include=dev && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.start-ui: concurrently "npm run start-captcha-server" "npm run start-job-manager" "npm run start-ui-dev"
scripts.start-booking-edge: concurrently "npm run start-captcha-server" "npm run wait-for-captcha-server && cypress run --headed --browser edge --no-exit"
scripts.postinstall: if [ "$CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY" != "0" ]; then npx cypress install; fi; if [ "$RENDER" = "true" ]; then PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 npx playwright install chromium; fi

author: Prince Shrivastava
